python3 -c '
import json, os, sys
from pathlib import Path

hook = sys.argv[1]
home = Path.home()
cwd = Path.cwd()

roots = []
for v in ("CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT", "CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT"):
    if os.environ.get(v): roots.append(Path(os.environ[v]))
roots += [cwd] + list(cwd.parents)

installed = home / ".claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json"
if installed.is_file():
    data = json.loads(installed.read_text())
    for e in data.get("plugins", {}).get("forge@forge", []):
        if e.get("installPath"): roots.append(Path(e["installPath"]))

script = next((r / "hooks" / hook for r in roots if (r / "AGENTS.md").is_file() and (r / "hooks" / hook).is_file()), None)
if script:
    os.environ["CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT"] = str(script.parents[1])
    os.execvp("bash", ["bash", str(script)])
print(json.dumps({}))
' session-start.sh
